TSB Revision
SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-97
CIRCUIT OPERATION
A signal from the windshield washer switch is sent 
through the column-ECU inside the column switch to 
the front-ECU. The signal turns on the relay inside 
the front-ECU to operate the washer motor.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
The washer motor, the column switch (windshield 
wiper and washer switch) or the front-ECU may be 
defective.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the washer motor
• Malfunction of the column switch (windshield 
wiper and washer switch)
• Malfunction of the front-ECU 
• Damaged harness wires and connectors
